column1: # Which arithmetic lane is wired where. One row per (lane, family, route, operand types).
# How the rows are used: lanes/gen-tables.cmake compiles them in when CMake configures (lanes-table.h, with capability.tsv).
# The selector, ggml_metal_negotiate_lane_in (lanes/select.cpp), reads only these two tables. No file is read at run time.
# It negotiates between the tensor type of the request (the model's requirement) and the card's capability rows: of the rows
# of the family and route that are on, it takes the one that holds the activation natively, else exactly another way, else
# wider. A row whose operand is narrower than the tensor is dropped. Equal steps go in file order, so the base row comes last.
# No row left = a coverage gap: the selector returns none.
# To add a lane: write its file, add its row with default off, run its test on the card, then turn it on.
# Columns
#   lane: the lane's name, the same as its file name without the extension.
#   source: who compiles the lane: metal (the Metal shader compiler) | llvm-archive | llvm-native (LLVM, see llvm/toolchain.tsv). No llvm row exists yet.
#   file: the file that holds the lane, relative to this backend's folder. The table check fails when it does not exist.
#   family: the op family: matmul | flash-attn.
#   route: the route of the family: mv-scalar | mv-grouped | mm-tiled | mm-matrix | fa-scalar | fa-vec | fa-matrix | fa-intel-tiled.
#   weight: the weight type the row is for (a type name such as q4_K), or any = every type.
#   activation: the activation type the row is for (f32 | f16 | bf16), or any = every type.
#   operand: the format the lane holds an activation in while it forms products (f32 | f16 | bf16).

#   holds: how the operand holds the row's activation type: native | exact-other | wider | narrower. For activation any the request's type decides. The generator refuses a cell that contradicts operand and activation.
#   entry: the suffix of the lane's kernel entry point, or - = the route's own entry.
#   capability: the capability the card must have, a lane name of capability.tsv, or - = none needed.
#   class: what the lane does to the values: exact | product-rounded | narrows.

#   origin: ours | upstream. upstream = a route that stages narrower types as shipped upstream. It is listed here and taken by its family's dispatch, not chosen by the selector, so it names no capability.
#   default: on | off. on = measured and reviewed, may be picked. off = the lane exists and is never picked.
#   seam_us: the cost in microseconds of handing the op to another submit route, 0 = none. A row with a cost is never picked.
#   id: the value of the pipeline lane constant, also part of the pipeline name. 0 for the base lane.
#   reason: why the row lands on its holds value. Free text, no tab.
#   test: the command that proves the row on a card before default is set to on. Free text, no tab.
